# What's new in 0.3.1

Released **2026-10-03**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../../CHANGELOG.md).

Product name: **steadyGrind**.

## Highlights

- Product renamed to **steadyGrind** (app, DMG, dialogs, docs)
- **Ride structure + power overlay** — zone profile and adherence power on one −2m…+8m chart
- Settings **Record session with Garmin** help (ANT+ power meter pairing, watch settings, Strava tips)
- Open **Settings during a ride** without being snapped back; **Back to ride** while a session is active

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-0.3.1-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v0.3.1
